name: StackQL
description: Queries, provisions, and manages resources across 40+ cloud and SaaS providers with SQL from a shell, a Postgres-wire server, or an MCP server, for platform engineers and AI agents.

skills.name: SQL Resource Queries
skills.description: Queries cloud and SaaS resources with SELECT statements that are transpiled into provider API calls.

skills.name: SQL Provisioning
skills.description: Creates and changes resources with INSERT and other mutating SQL statements.

skills.name: Postgres-Wire Server
skills.description: Runs as a service that Postgres clients reach over the wire protocol with mTLS, optionally alongside MCP.

skills.name: MCP Server
skills.description: Exposes SQL over 40+ providers to MCP clients via stdio, npm, PyPI, Docker, or .mcpb bundles.
